newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Analysts' comments on Akzo Nobel results.
newsitem.headline: Analysts' comments on Akzo Nobel results.

text.p: Chemicals group Akzo Nobel NV announced a 1996 net profit excluding extraordinary items of 1.32 billion guilders, barely up on the 1.31 billion reported for 1995. The dividend rose to 7.5 guilders from 7.00 guilders. Analysts had forecast a net profit excluding extraordinaries of 1.30 to 1.35 billion guilders.
Below is a collection of analysts' comments on the results.
"The result is somewhat lower than I expected, although the figures came as no real surprise."

"If you look at the breakdown of the figures, chemicals were a bit lower than expected and fibres were better than expected -- the fourth quarter didn't show the loss we anticipated. Coatings were weaker than we had expected although pharmaceuticals did better, probably because of the stronger dollar.

"The company has made a positive outlook but the only point is that they don't see sales growth. That should mean you're getting better results through cost savings and lower raw material prices, and that's not that impressive."

"The figures were higher than I expected, I was looking for net profit of 1.304 billion guilders or 18.35 guilders per share. The strong results from the pharma division were very encouraging -- very, very positive.
"Raising the dividend to 7.50 guilders from 7.00 was also positive because the earnings were flat. It's only possible to do that if you're quite positive about the current year.
"I'm not going to change my estimate that much for this year as it was already for a 12 percent rise in earnings per share."

"The bottom-line figure was in line with our expectations, with pharma doing far better and Chemicals somewhat disappointing. 1996 has been a transition year, as Nobel had to be fully integrated. Now that's been achieved, and in 1997 Akzo will receive a lot of cash-flow out of its Chemicals division, which can be pumped into investments for new pharma products and a more aggresive worldwide strategy in Coatings.
"The common decision of the sale of Securum's remaining stake in Akzo is very positive as it will take away the pressure of a pending share-offering.
